title: Heated bimetal strip: laminate curvature and interface stress jump (analytic)
description:
Half of a free bimetal strip (two 50 um layers: aluminium-like E 70 GPa, alpha 23e-6 below, steel-like E 200 GPa, alpha 12e-6 above, nu 0.3 both; plane strain) heated uniformly by dT = 100 K (temperature_change feature, no heat physics). x_lo is the symmetry plane (roller); one fixed_domain pin cell at the bottom of x_lo stops the y translation; every other face is free.
Analytic (laminate theory, exact away from the free end): plane strain turns E_i into E_i' = E_i / (1 - nu^2) and alpha_i into alpha_i' = (1 + nu) alpha_i; strain_xx = eps0 + kappa y (y from the bottom) with A = sum E_i' t_i, B = sum E_i' int y dy, D = sum E_i' int y^2 dy, N_T = dT sum E_i' alpha_i' t_i, M_T = dT sum E_i' alpha_i' int y dy: kappa = (A M_T - B N_T) / (A D - B^2) (-19.9 1/m: the strip curls upward, the aluminium side convex), eps0 = (D N_T - B M_T) / (A D - B^2); sigma_xx = E_i' (eps0 + kappa y - alpha_i' dT), jumping at the interface (about -63 MPa in the aluminium to +134 MPa in the steel); sigma_zz = nu sigma_xx - E_i alpha_i dT; u_x = (eps0 + kappa y) x, u_y = -kappa x^2 / 2 + const. Cross-check: Timoshenko's bimetal formula for equal thicknesses, kappa = -24 dalpha' dT / (h (12 + (1 + n)(1 + 1/n))), n = E_al / E_steel (1.5 dalpha' dT / h for n = 1), gives the same kappa.
Comparison window: x = 3 h .. L - 3 h (selections interior, row_below, row_above), away from the pin and the free end (end effects decay over ~h). Bilinear elements are slightly too stiff in bending (32 cells over the depth: ~0.575 / 32^2 = 0.06 %; 16 cells gave 0.27 %). The pin cell cannot expand, so the far field carries a rigid offset (translation + rotation, ~4 alpha' dT dx^2 / h at the bottom fibre): ~0.6 % of the u_x range at dx = 6.25 um, hence dx = 3.125 um (~0.15 %).
Derived values tab: curvature (from the strain_xx moment over the window; also against the Timoshenko value), strain_mid (strain_xx at the interface height), sigma_below / sigma_above (the cell rows either side of the interface) and sigma_zz_above; expected ~1e-3 or better (tolerance 5e-3).
Line profile tab: sigma_xx_depth across the strip at x = 0.5 mm (piecewise linear with the jump), u_x_bottom and u_y_bottom along the bottom cell row (both within that pin offset; u_y ~0.5 % of its range, tolerance 2 %).

parameters.name: E_al
parameters.description: Young's modulus of the lower (aluminium-like) layer in Pa

parameters.name: alpha_al
parameters.description: thermal expansion of the lower layer in 1/K

parameters.name: E_st
parameters.description: Young's modulus of the upper (steel-like) layer in Pa

parameters.name: alpha_st
parameters.description: thermal expansion of the upper layer in 1/K

parameters.name: nu_strip
parameters.description: Poisson ratio of both layers

parameters.name: t_layer
parameters.description: thickness of each layer

parameters.name: h_strip
parameters.description: total strip thickness

parameters.name: L_half
parameters.description: modelled half length (x_lo = symmetry plane, x_hi = free end)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (16 cells per layer: the pin offset ~ dx^2 stays below the u_x tolerance)

parameters.name: dT
parameters.description: uniform temperature change in K

parameters.name: x_a
parameters.description: start of the comparison window (3 h from the symmetry plane and pin)

parameters.name: x_b
parameters.description: end of the comparison window (3 h from the free end)

parameters.name: E1p
parameters.description: plane-strain modulus of the lower layer in Pa

parameters.name: E2p
parameters.description: plane-strain modulus of the upper layer in Pa

parameters.name: a1p
parameters.description: plane-strain expansion of the lower layer in 1/K

parameters.name: a2p
parameters.description: plane-strain expansion of the upper layer in 1/K

parameters.name: A_lam
parameters.description: laminate extensional stiffness A in N/m

parameters.name: B_lam
parameters.description: laminate coupling stiffness B (moments about y = 0) in N

parameters.name: D_lam
parameters.description: laminate bending stiffness D (about y = 0) in N m

parameters.name: N_T
parameters.description: thermal force resultant in N/m

parameters.name: M_T
parameters.description: thermal moment resultant about y = 0 in N

parameters.name: det_lam
parameters.description: A D - B^2

parameters.name: kappa_ref
parameters.description: analytic curvature d(strain_xx)/dy in 1/m (u_y = -kappa x^2 / 2)

parameters.name: eps0_ref
parameters.description: analytic strain_xx at the bottom face y = 0

parameters.name: n_ratio
parameters.description: modulus ratio n of the Timoshenko formula

parameters.name: kappa_timo
parameters.description: Timoshenko bimetal curvature for equal layer thicknesses in 1/m (cross-check of kappa_ref)

parameters.name: y_below
parameters.description: cell-centre height of the row just below the interface

parameters.name: y_above
parameters.description: cell-centre height of the row just above the interface

parameters.name: sigma_below_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_xx in the row below the interface in Pa

parameters.name: sigma_above_ref
parameters.description: analytic sigma_xx in the row above the interface in Pa

parameters.name: x_cut
parameters.description: x of the through-thickness stress line (a cell centre)

analytic_curves.name: sigma_xx_depth
analytic_curves.expression: where(y < t_layer, E1p*(eps0_ref + kappa_ref*y - a1p*dT), E2p*(eps0_ref + kappa_ref*y - a2p*dT))
